text:
Banks led a broad rally on Friday as Sensex gained nearly 900 points.

• Sensex closed at 83,919.71, up 897.96 points (1.08%); Nifty 50 closed at 25,800.60, up 286.30 points (1.12%), per DSIJ and Chinimandi closing reports.
• Nifty Bank rose 2.49%, per Kotak Neo and DSIJ closing reports.
• Nifty Midcap 100 gained 0.66%, per Kotak Neo and DSIJ.
• Reports cited buying in banking and IT shares and foreign investor inflows.

Our view: when a heavyweight sector moves 2%+, it can account for a large share of an index gain, so the headline number may say more about banks than about the average stock. One session is a thin sample; we read this as sector leadership, not a trend. This is an interpretation, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: when one sector drives an index move, how do you explain it to clients who hold diversified portfolios?
